subject: english
stem: A filter article says two layers remove more particles than one. Counts after filtering: one layer 30 particles; two layers 18; three layers 17. What is the careful conclusion?
options: Each added layer removed exactly 12 particles.
Three layers left more particles than one.
The largest drop was from one to two layers.

optionRationales.reason: Each added layer removed exactly 12 particles.：第三層只再少一。
Three layers left more particles than one.：17 低於 30。
Layer number made no difference.：前兩組差大。
The largest drop was from one to two layers.：30→18 減十二，18→17 只減一。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「文字提出的關係需由數據方向、差值與單位共同驗證」可推出 The largest drop was from one to two layers.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The largest drop was from one to two layers. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
